source_text: Non omnis allegoria violenta sit; serviat aedificationi. Lex litterae custodem habet; spiritus vivificat. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Not every allegory violent let-it-be; let-it-serve to-edification. Law of-letter guard has; spirit makes-alive. Amen.
pass_b_english: Let no allegory be forced; let it serve edification. The letter has its guard; [[the Spirit gives life >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:6]]. Amen.
